market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. CPI data today is pivotal; if inflation confirms upward tick, expect Fed hike repricing, equity sell-off, and bond yield spike. Oil at $108 with Houthi escalation creates tail risk. Diesel at $6/gallon pressures consumer and transport sectors. Credit inversion signals stress. Expect volatility spike into CPI print.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for selective sectors. AI infrastructure (optical, security, data centers) remains structurally supported. Energy transition (solar/storage in Europe) offers 3-5 year growth. Higher rates become new normal, favoring value, energy, and financials. Geopolitical fragmentation creates trade flow opportunities in Global South. AI monetization phase will separate winners from laggards by Q1 2027.
